title: Guideline Sodium intake for adults and children
doc_summary:
Here are 7 concise bullet points on recommendations and behaviour-change measures:
* Reduce sodium intake to less than 2g per day for adults and children
* Decrease sodium intake through public health interventions such as food and product labelling
* Implement consumer education on the risks of high sodium intake
* Establish food-based dietary guidelines to promote low sodium intake
* Reduce sodium content in foods and products through reformulation
* Promote the use of salt substitutes and flavour enhancers to reduce sodium intake
* Develop and implement policies to support reduction of sodium intake in populations
